answer: Make every vouch carry postage. Each attestation an agent sends must include a memory-hard stamp bound to sender, recipient and epoch, about 20 seconds of work (assumed). An honest agent mailing 20 vouches spends roughly 7 minutes. A ring of 500 clones vouching 20 siblings apiece must mint 10,000 stamps, about 55 CPU-hours per epoch (assumed). Memory-hardness keeps cheap GPUs from shrinking that bill. A clone ring is a hall of mirror images praising itself; postage makes that praise hollow and costly, a drop for one agent, an ocean for a farm.
